title: Anonymizer Substitution Audit
brief: A log anonymizer disguises identifiers by swapping each character for a replacement character, always using the same replacement for the same original and never giving two different originals the same replacement. Compliance wants a tool that checks whether a disguised string could really have come from a given original this way.

Implement isConsistentCipher(s, t), where s is the original string and t is the disguised one of the same length, and return true if t can be produced from s by such a character-for-character substitution, and false otherwise.

followUpDirections.direction: Ask the candidate to restate the inputs, outputs, constraints, and ambiguities.
Ask the candidate to choose and trace an ordinary example and a boundary case.
Ask for the candidate's approach, correctness argument, and complexity.
Ask the candidate to implement their stated approach and explain major decisions.
Ask the candidate to predict useful cases and expected results before running them.
Ask for complexity, an uncovered edge case, and a justified optimization or cleanup.
